task.title: Connect account-owner authenticator replacement to restricted re-enrollment
task.input: M3-T3 TOTP_RESET grants and M3-T5 restricted re-enrollment.
task.output: SELF_REAUTH restricted sessions and compatible legacy responses from POST /api/admin/account/2fa/reset.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real 2fa/reset -> current device plus transactional TOTP_RESET consumption -> SELF_REAUTH restricted cookie/enrollLink. The compatible currentPassword+totp path has equal strength and rejects recoveryCode. Keep the original factor until final confirm; a restricted-cookie admin request returns 401 (E-14). 2) Without the current password, passwordless-session/TOTP-only grant issuance or direct reset rejects without a factor change. A valid owner grant permits restricted enroll/confirm and audited new enrollment. A forgotten password requires separate OS-owner preauthorization, not a self-chosen HTTP password (E-75).
